posts.Title: Project Start
posts.Situation:
I have decided to make LLM agent grid-based 2D game in Axmol the Game engine. LLM would run externally via OpenAI API. There was few questions about axmol.

Was Axmol a outdated dead game engine?

Why Axmol?

Will Axmol be able to connect with LLM backend?
posts.Task: Check if the game engine was still actively worked on. Show my reason about the choice. Create proof of concept for LLM Backend communication in Axmol.
posts.Action:
Check Axmol github for updates.

Make a short presentation on why I choose Axmol for this game project.

Get user input, send API request to LLM backend and display the response to screen in Axmol.
posts.Result:
Axmol dev branch is updated very frequently.

I have created a short presentation on why I choose Axmol for this project.

Created proof of concept in Axmol for LLM connection via API and used Koboldcpp as backend. Axmol has dedicated module for http requests which meet all of my requierments.
